    About

    Who I Am

    I’m Amit Baranwal, a Senior Software Development Engineer at Amazon based in Bengaluru, India. Over 11+ years at Amazon, I’ve built systems across Fulfilment by Amazon, Supply Chain Optimisation, Identity Verification, and Seller Onboarding — working at the intersection of large-scale distributed systems and real-world logistics.

    Before Amazon, I worked on Oracle’s Recovery Manager (RMAN) and Zero Data Loss Recovery Appliance, building database restore and near-zero data loss features in C and Perl.

    What I’m Building Toward

    I’m an AI-native architect who builds intelligent developer tools. My current focus areas:

    • Generative AI applied to developer productivity — exploring how AI transforms how we build software
    • Systems thinking — connecting supply chain optimization patterns to software architecture
    • Building in public — sharing the journey of creating indie developer tool products

    Career Journey

    Amazon — Senior Software Development Engineer (Dec 2019 – Present) Working on Fulfilment by Amazon and Supply Chain Optimisation products. Technical leadership across large-scale distributed systems serving millions of sellers.

    Amazon — Software Development Engineer (Jan 2015 – Nov 2019) Built systems for Fulfilment by Amazon, Identity Verification, Seller Onboarding and Compliance products.

    Oracle — Member of Technical Staff (Jun 2013 – Dec 2014) Worked on Database Restore Range and Near Zero Data Loss features of Recovery Manager (RMAN) and Zero Data Loss Recovery Appliance (ZDLRA).

    Microsoft — Software Engineer Intern (May 2012 – Jun 2012) Implemented Hyperlink Generation, Send My Location, Meeting & Voice Mail for WLync on Windows Phone.

    Education

    IIT (BHU) Varanasi — B.Tech, Computer Science (2009–2013), Grade: 8.60/10
